# docs.langchain.com documentation — Oss

> 25 page(s) of docs.langchain.com documentation under Oss. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Oss

- [Approval modes](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/approval-modes.md): By default, Deep Agents Code asks for your approval before running potentially consequential actions.
- [Command reference](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/cli-reference.md): Deep Agents Code (`dcode`) accepts command-line flags at launch and exposes management subcommands for tools, agents, sessions, skills, credentials, and configuration.
- [Config file](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/config-file.md): `~/.deepagents/config.toml` lets you customize model providers, set defaults, and pass extra parameters to model constructors.
- [Configuration](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/configuration.md): Deep Agents Code stores user configuration in its profile directory, which defaults to `~/.deepagents/`, and in project-level dotfiles.
- [Provider credentials](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/credentials.md): Deep Agents Code needs an API key for each model provider you use. The recommended way to add one is the [`/auth`](#use-%2Fauth-recommended) credential manager.
- [Python extensions](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/extensions.md): Python extensions customize the dcode agent server without modifying dcode itself. Use them to register model tools, LangChain middleware, virtual storage routes.
- [Goals and rubrics](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/goals-and-rubrics.md): Goals and rubrics help Deep Agents Code check whether its work satisfies the criteria you care about.
- [Hooks](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/hooks.md): Hooks let external programs observe and control Deep Agents Code lifecycle events.
- [MCP tools](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/mcp-tools.md): [MCP (Model Context Protocol)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) lets you extend Deep Agents Code with tools from external servers—file systems, APIs, databases, and more—without…
- [Memory and Skills](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/memory-and-skills.md): There are two primary ways to customize an agent in Deep Agents Code: - **[Memory](#memory)**: `AGENTS.md` files and auto-saved memories that persist across sessions.
- [Deep Agents Code](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/overview.md): Deep Agents Code (`dcode`) is an open source coding agent built on the [Deep Agents SDK](/oss/python/deepagents/quickstart).
- [Plugins and marketplaces](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/plugins.md): Plugins extend dcode with reusable [skills](/oss/deepagents/code/memory-and-skills), [MCP servers](/oss/deepagents/code/mcp-tools), [hooks](/oss/deepagents/code/hooks), and…
- [Model providers](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/providers.md): Deep Agents Code supports any [chat model provider compatible with LangChain](/oss/python/integrations/chat), unlocking use for virtually any LLM that supports tool calling.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/quickstart.md): Deep Agents Code (`dcode`) is a terminal coding agent built on the [Deep Agents SDK](/oss/python/deepagents/quickstart).
- [Use remote sandboxes](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/remote-sandboxes.md): Deep Agents Code uses the [sandbox as tool](/oss/python/deepagents/sandboxes#sandbox-as-tool-pattern) pattern: the `dcode` process (LLM loop, memory, tool dispatch) runs on your…
- [Use subagents in Deep Agents Code](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/deepagents/code/subagents.md): Define custom synchronous [subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents) as markdown files so Deep Agents Code can delegate specialized tasks to them.
- [Automate updates](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/automate-updates.md): OpenWiki can refresh repository documentation on a schedule and open a pull request or merge request when the wiki changes.
- [Command reference](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/cli-reference.md): OpenWiki ships as a single `openwiki` binary for interactive chat and one-shot documentation runs. For installation and first use, see [Quickstart](/oss/openwiki/quickstart).
- [Code mode](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/code-mode.md): Code mode builds a repository wiki in `openwiki/` with durable details such as architecture, integrations, and workflows.
- [Customize OpenWiki](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/customize.md): Customize OpenWiki with ignore rules, wiki briefs, agent instruction pointers, and telemetry.
- [OpenWiki](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/overview.md): OpenWiki is an open source CLI that writes and maintains a Markdown wiki about your codebase or personal knowledge.
- [Personal mode](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/personal-mode.md): Personal mode builds a local personal brain wiki in `~/.openwiki/wiki` from configured sources such as local repositories, Gmail, Notion, web search, Hacker News, Slack, and…
- [Model providers](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/providers.md): OpenWiki supports the following providers:.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/quickstart.md): OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains a Markdown wiki for your codebase or personal knowledge.
- [Visualize your wiki](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/openwiki/visualize.md): For exploring OpenWiki Markdown wikis, `openwiki visualize` serves a local interactive node graph beside a live Markdown reader in your browser.
